text: Basic Electronics Company Ltd — the company behind the Al-Asasyah (الأساسية) brand — is a limited liability company owned by Mohammed Ahmed Al-Arfaj, and describes itself as a 100% Saudi company.

source.name: Al-Asasyah / Basic Electronics Company – About us (company website)
source.quote: شركة الكترونيات أساسية المحدودة هي شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة تملكها السيد محمد أحمد العرفج
source.note: Translation of the quote: 'Basic Electronics Company Ltd is a limited liability company owned by Mr Mohammed Ahmed Al-Arfaj'. The same page states in English: 'BASIC ELECTRONICS COMPANY LTD. is 100% a Saudi company.' The page is undated; the date is the day it was opened.
